BiblicalUsage: Ithamar was the youngest son of Aaron, and his name runs through the priestly records from Exodus to Numbers. When Nadab and Abihu died for offering strange fire, Ithamar and his brother Eleazar carried the priesthood on, and Moses charged him with the care of the Gershonites and Merarites and their service of the tabernacle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ithamar shows that God's work goes on even after terrible loss. The priesthood did not end with Nadab and Abihu; God kept a line of servants, and ordinary faithfulness — carrying the tabernacle, tending the service — is how His worship stood.
